notes: Andy's pick'em / confidence pools. Games lock at each game's kickoff in all three. Strategy profiles drive scripts/pickem-card.mjs; standings are filled in from Andy's leaderboard screenshots.

pools.name: SimplySportsware confidence pool
pools.strategy_note: Three of four prizes are cumulative -> maximize expected points; evidence nudges of 1 slot only, placed by hand.

pools.name: Yahoo confidence pool
pools.strategy_note: Weekly prize in a ~95 field -> cheap differentiation: at most one heavy-favorite fade (fav >= 65%) at a low slot plus contrarian sides on near coin flips, all backed by tier 1-2 card evidence, within an expected-points budget.

pools.name: CBS straight-up pick'em
pools.strategy_note: Market favorites; differentiate only on near coin flips (fav <= 57%) where tier 1-2 evidence backs the dog.
